brief: Breakout opportunity: Modular AI agents for engineering tasks (mattpocock/skills).
AI-powered lazy coding assistant (DietrichGebert/ponytail) and plugin-based framework (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) are also trending.
AI gateway with 352 providers and 1200+ models (anomalyco/opencode) is a strong contender.
Breakout timing: Q3 2023 for AI agents and assistants, Q4 for AI gateways.
